by: candidate-returns session, step 4.1 (proposed; the integrator appends it at candidate-returns-1)
title: Electorate candidate return of donations and expenses (2020 form; 2023 adds loans), declaration page with a text layer

landmarks: the declaration page: heading '2. TOTAL CANDIDATE DONATIONS' then Parts A, C, D and 'Total (A + C + D)'
'3. TOTAL CANDIDATE ELECTION EXPENSES' then Parts F, G and 'Total (F + G)'
2023: '4. TOTAL CANDIDATE LOANS' then Part H

signals_note: Recognised by shape: a PDF of 1 to 20 pages whose declaration page (the first page carrying the donations heading, nearly always page 1) has a text layer of at least 80 characters. Pages behind it may be images; only the declaration page is read for the totals.
notes: Read with pdftotext -layout (registers/candidate_returns/declaration.py, layout mode). The form's thresholds ($1,500, $50) are its text; the right-hand checklist is cut at its own column; figures are given to labels by the section's own arithmetic. A fillable form's own arithmetic can print three or four decimals (16112.988): rounded to the cent. A scanner's OCR layer is itself a reading and can miss a handwritten figure (the outside check names it).
applies_to: Candidate returns for the 2020 and 2023 general elections and the 2022 Tauranga by-election, as held under the old estate's var/staging/ec-donations/ (archive/, residue/candidate_returns_2020/)
process: Read each section: the step cell, then the parts and the total.
The year, candidate, party and electorate come from the Commission's listing; the page's own are kept as filed.
gates: Each section's parts sum to its printed total, or the section is a declared NIL, or its parts are blank with one figure typed in its step cell.
A figure that is not zero is never left unpaired.
A step cell holding a figure equals the section's figure.
on_fail: set aside: stage 'declaration' with the section's problem

by: candidate-returns session, step 4.1 (proposed; the integrator appends it at candidate-returns-1)
title: Electorate candidate return whose declaration page is an image: read from the page reader's stored reading

landmarks: no text page carries the donations heading; a stored page reading does

signals_note: No page with a text layer carries the declaration; the page reader's reading of an image page does. Without a stored reading the return is set aside and named for a re-read (the scheduler's job, never this lane).

declaration: as ec-candidate-return-text, one figure on its label's line

notes: Replayed, never called. The trial (step 3) stored readings of these returns under ec-candidate-expenses-return@5 at 200 dpi; any GLM-OCR reading with the prompt 'OCR' under a candidate-return profile is taken. Read in plain mode: no columns; the quoted 'NIL' in the step sentence is the form's text; a hyphen for the point counts only after '$' ($2915-82).
applies_to: As ec-candidate-return-text, where the declaration page is an image
process: Find the first page whose stored reading carries the donations heading.
Read it as the text profile does.
on_fail: set aside: stage 'read' (no stored reading, naming the pages) or 'declaration'

each row a of cells '

Name

…'

signals_note: Paged by ?start=N. A page the browser kept can be a challenge page with no table: it gives no rows and is named.
notes: The Commission's own words on the page: 'If we receive an amended return from a candidate, we will publish the amended version and if applicable adjust the summary table.' The link in a row is the candidate's current return.
applies_to: elections.nz/democracy-in-nz/historical-events/<2020|2023>-general-election…/candidate-expenses-…, as kept under the old estate's var/staging/ec-donations/index/live-*.html
process: Rows de-duplicated across pages kept on different days (rows shift between pages).
gates: Every figure reads to money or NIL.
on_fail: a catch-log line naming the page

by: candidate-returns session, step 4.1 (proposed; the integrator appends it at candidate-returns-1)
title: elections.nz summary spreadsheet of candidate returns (2020-Candidate-Returns.xlsx; 2023-candidate-returns-updated-DDMMYYYY .csv/.xlsx)

landmarks: header row naming electorate, surname or last name, first name(s), donations, expenses; 2023 adds year and total loans

signals_note: A file named .csv that is an HTML page (the 22 August 2024 version is a challenge page the archive kept) is refused, never read as an empty table.
notes: The lane's outside figure, joined on year, electorate and surname (macrons, case and hyphens aside), the given name deciding between two. 'NIL' is 0.00; 'Return not received' / 'not received' is no return; the Commission's own typing is read where unambiguous ('$4,250,00', '$20.895.09'). The newest version that is a table is the one checked.
applies_to: As held under the old estate's var/staging/ec-donations/ (archive/, residue/candidate_returns_2020/)
process: Header row found in the first ten rows.
gates: Every figure reads to money, NIL or not received.
on_fail: a catch-log line naming the file and row
